lines.lyric_translation: Girl, where did you come from?
What a mystery, where are you going?
How old are you? Are you older than me?

lines.lyric: A airakko? geugam naega ma oppayane
lines.lyric_hangul: 아 아이라꼬? 그캄 내가 마 오빠야네
lines.lyric_translation: You’re not? Then I’m your oppa!
(Awesome) Your face is so small and pretty
You look fresh like a salad, so smooth

lines.lyric: Bab munna? kkadaegi chineun geo aida
lines.lyric_hangul: 밥 뭇나? 까대기 치는 거 아이다
lines.lyric_translation: Did you eat? I’m not just hitting on you
Wanna get a cup of coffee? Is coffee okay?

lines.lyric: Yeppeun nun, yeppeun ko, atta geobnage ippeoing
lines.lyric_hangul: 예쁜 눈, 예쁜 코, 아따 겁나게 이뻐잉
lines.lyric_translation: Pretty eyes, pretty nose, you’re so pretty

lines.lyric: Baraman bogo isseodo geunyang naega da gippeoing
lines.lyric_hangul: 바라만 보고 있어도 그냥 내가 다 기뻐잉
lines.lyric_translation: Just looking at you makes me happy
But where did you come from?
You’re so pretty

lines.lyric: Kyupiteu hwasallo nae mameul kok jjigeoing
lines.lyric_hangul: 큐피트 화살로 내 맘을 콕 찍어잉
lines.lyric_translation: Cupid’s arrow pierced my heart
Anyway, you’re such a fair lady
Any guy, after looking at you
can fall for you
I need to approach you before
someone else steals you
I will bite down on you first
Where did you come from?
Will you tell me your name?
I’m so curious
I’m really so curious
Where did you come from?
Will you tell me your name?
I’m so curious
I’m really so curious
I’m from Busan, you’re from Gwangju
But we’re the same
Even here in Seoul, even there in Jeju Island
Everyone is in love, oh yeah

lines.lyric: Goma jjom tinggira, gungdireul juchappugi jeone
lines.lyric_hangul: 고마 쫌 팅기라, 궁디를 주차뿌기 전에
lines.lyric_translation: Stop playing hard to get before I kick you in the butt

lines.lyric: Jjangnage haji mara jjom nae mam bakkugi jeone
lines.lyric_hangul: 짱나게 하지 마라 쫌 내 맘 바꾸기 전에
lines.lyric_translation: Don’t make me mad, before I change my mind

lines.lyric: Jeomman geunyang eollada ni geumma ttaemae ikana?
lines.lyric_hangul: 점만 그냥 얼라다 니 금마 때매 이카나?
lines.lyric_translation: He isn’t good, are you acting this way because of him?

lines.lyric: Nae nattugo geotta jotakanikka nae an sseungnana
lines.lyric_hangul: 내 나뚜고 거따 조타카니까 내 안 씅나나
lines.lyric_translation: Of course I’m mad because you like him and not me

lines.lyric: Gaseunaya jangnan ttong ttaerina? nuni ppinna
lines.lyric_hangul: 가스나야 장난 똥 때리나? 눈이 삣나
lines.lyric_translation: Girl, are you joking? Are you blind?
The world is covered with guys like that
That guy only knows himself

lines.lyric: Nae mam, da ije da ni kkida nan nippi moreunda
lines.lyric_hangul: 내 맘, 다 이제 다 니 끼다 난 니삐 모른다
lines.lyric_translation: My heart is all yours now, I only know you

lines.lyric: Ome ome i gashina nahante haneun jit boso
lines.lyric_hangul: 오메 오메 이 가시나 나한테 하는 짓 보소
lines.lyric_translation: Oh my, look at what this girl is doing to me
What she’s doing
to me is no joke

lines.lyric: Neo jakku geureomyeon nan eoltteoltteol shimjangi beolbeol
lines.lyric_hangul: 너 자꾸 그러면 난 얼떨떨 심장이 벌벌
lines.lyric_translation: If you keep doing that, my heart will be trembling
My hands will shake and I’ll run out of breath

lines.lyric: Shibang jigeum nal joahae, geoshigi geoshigihae?
lines.lyric_hangul: 시방 지금 날 좋아해, 거시기 거시기해?
lines.lyric_translation: Are you saying you like me right now?

lines.lyric: Jigeum ni mameun ontong da, hoshigi hoshigihae?
lines.lyric_hangul: 지금 니 맘은 온통 다, 호시기 호시기해?
lines.lyric_translation: Is that how you feel right now?

lines.lyric: Atta geuraedo jeollado namjaga kkeulligin hangabda
lines.lyric_hangul: 아따 그래도 전라도 남자가 끌리긴 한갑다
lines.lyric_translation: I guess you are attracted to Jeollado guys

lines.lyric: A matta, geundi neon eodiseo wattanya?
lines.lyric_hangul: 아 맞다, 근디 넌 어디서 왔다냐?
lines.lyric_translation: Oh right, where are you from again?

Will you tell me your name?

I’m really so curious

I don’t care

I’m a pretty cool guy too
We have no choice but to fall in love
Yeah I’m fallin in love
